videos.desc: A father and son walk through a dark tunnel and step out inside a huge indoor arena packed with thousands of fans around a basketball court; they gape at the stands in awe, then cheer and throw their popcorn in the air.
On a misty field an archer holds a feathered arrow up to the camera, nocks it on her bow and shoots at a distant target; the arrow hits the bullseye and she pulls it out and shows it proudly.

At a stadium track meet, athletes compete in different events: a woman sprints over hurdles, a man leaps into the long-jump sand pit, and a woman hurls the shot put, then the three celebrate together.

In a gym two people load big black plates onto a bar and clip them tight; a blonde woman chalks her hands, grips the heavy barbell and deadlifts it to a stand while friends watch, then drops it and celebrates.

In an anime-style clip, a silver-haired older woman draws a wooden bow, aims the arrow with narrowed eyes and hits the bullseye of a straw target; her big bearded companion celebrates and hands her the next arrow.
videos.said: Wow, that's tight! Aha! Dead center!

videos.desc: A soccer player on a rainy pitch holds up a boot to show the studded sole, laces the black cleats on at the bench, then sprints across wet grass and digs the studs into the mud without slipping, grinning at the camera.

A young man grabs a black plate-loaded dumbbell from a yoga mat, does biceps curls with it and presses it overhead in the living room. His girlfriend watches from an armchair sipping coffee and applauds as he sets it down grinning.

In an indoor futsal match, a player in orange dribbles the ball and a defender in purple grabs and trips her from behind. The referee blows the whistle, raises her arm and points for a free kick while the guilty player protests with his hands up.

On a pitch at sunset a player in maroon places the ball on the line while a wall of defenders in black lines up in front of the goal. He runs up and curls the free kick over the wall; the goalkeeper dives but the ball flies in, and the taker slides on his knees celebrating while the wall curses.

On a rooftop helipad at sunset, a man performs freestyle football tricks: juggling the ball with his feet, balancing it on his head and on his shoe, and holding a handstand with the ball resting on his foot.
In a locker room a coach hands a young footballer a folded light-blue jersey; she unfolds it to reveal the number 7, pulls it on over her shirt and turns to show her teammates, who cheer and hug her.

On a floodlit caged pitch at night, a player in a white hoodie dribbles a football toward a defender in teal. He beats him with quick skill touches, sprints away with the ball at his feet and finishes by shooting into the small goal.
videos.said: Oh my head! No way, no way! He's gone!

videos.desc: On a sun-baked pitch a referee points to the spot; a player in orange places the ball on the penalty mark, takes a run-up and shoots past the diving green goalkeeper, then her whole team mobs her in celebration.

A groundskeeper in a flat cap mows the striped grass of a stadium football pitch, checks the fresh white lines with his boot, plants the yellow corner flag and stands proudly with crossed arms while players train in the background.

A cartoon referee holds up a black puck and drops it for a face-off between purple and yellow teams. A player in yellow wins it, skates up the ice, fires the puck past the purple goalie into the net and celebrates holding it up.
videos.said: Ready? Here it comes! Whoa! Yes! In!

videos.desc: A muscular man carries a big leather punching bag up a ladder in his garage and hangs it from a ceiling chain while a woman helps. He tests it with punches, makes it swing, celebrates and finally hugs the bag.

Two footballers face off one-on-one on indoor and outdoor pitches, chaining rapid stepovers, feints and direction changes to beat each other. Defenders lunge and slide in as the quick-cut compilation strings the fast moves together.
At a running track at dusk, a coach clicks an analog stopwatch as a sprinter takes off, stops it the moment she finishes, then stares at the dial in disbelief and celebrates the record time with her.

A point of view shot from one end of an orange clay tennis court, high in the mountains. The white lines of the court run away from the camera to the net across the middle, and beyond it a grey rock face with snow on top rises into a deep blue sky under a bright sun. On the far side of the net a player in red hits the ball back; the yellow ball bounces on the clay and crosses the net again and again. The player at the camera end reaches into the frame to play a shot, and the rally goes on across the empty court with the mountain behind it.

Two men in swimming shorts play with a ball in the shallow water of a sunny beach, sailing boats on the blue sea behind them. One man throws himself full length through the air to reach the ball and lands flat in the water with a big splash. Later he leaps up and kicks the ball over his own head with an overhead bicycle kick, both legs in the air. He lands in the water, then stands up in the shallows and raises both fists above his head in triumph while the other man bends over on the sand in the foreground.

Close-up of a footballer in a green and gold shirt standing in a line before a match at night. She has her hand flat on her chest and sings, tears running down both cheeks and her eyes red. Her team-mates stand beside her doing the same. A flag flies from a pole behind her, and the packed stand of spectators also stands with hands on their hearts.

A boy in a grey striped t shirt and navy shorts runs across a big park lawn with a black and white football at his feet, families sitting on the grass behind him. He flicks the ball up and bounces it on his knee, then dribbles on with a golden retriever trotting in from the side. He lines up in front of a small red, green and yellow plastic goal, swings his leg and drives the ball into the net past two jumpers laid out as markers. In the last shot he runs to another boy and the two of them hug and jump in front of the goal.

A rowing eight on a still river lined with willows, filmed from the bow. Eight rowers in matching navy kit and sunglasses drive back and forth in exact time, their oars dipping and lifting together and throwing up splashes on both sides. The cox sits facing them in the stern with headphones and a microphone. A cyclist passes along the towpath. At the end one rower punches a fist into the air.

A misty river at dawn with low sun through the willows. A rowing eight comes straight at the camera; the woman at the front, in a navy cap with a headset microphone at her mouth, shouts calls at the crew behind her, her mouth wide open. The rowers drive through the stroke in time with her, the boat surging and throwing spray off the blades. At the end the crew punch their fists up together.

On a sunny beach volleyball court by the sea, two players clap their hands together in a high five in close-up. The camera pulls back to show six young players in bright sports tops standing in a ring in the sand under the net; they laugh, pile all their hands one on top of another in the middle of the circle, then throw both arms straight up in the air together.
